base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl build-essential libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin libhdf5-dev wget ca-certificates
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate xopt-dev && echo ACTIVATION_OK'
runtime_smoke_command: python -c "from xopt.generators.ga.cnsga import CNSGAGenerator; print('CNSGAGenerator imported successfully')"

prepare_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl build-essential libopenmpi-dev openmpi-bin libhdf5-dev wget ca-certificates
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: dependencies already installed in environment; test patch applied separately
runtime_profile.notes: Base image ubuntu:22.04 with manually installed Miniforge. mpi4py requires OpenMPI system packages. Package installed in editable mode for development.

notes: Base image changed from condaforge/mambaforge:latest to ubuntu:22.04 to fix apt-get failure due to empty /etc/apt/sources.list. Miniforge is now installed manually via wget. System packages git and curl are installed via apt-get (not pre-provided by base image). The environment.yml file specifies all Python dependencies including numpy, torch, botorch, gpytorch, pandas, pydantic, deap, scipy, and mpi4py. The package is installed in editable mode with --no-dependencies since conda handles dependency resolution.
